title: ceanothus americanus var. intermedius
intro: Ceanothus americanus var. intermedius, commonly known as New Jersey Tea, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, promote wound healing, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of New Jersey Tea include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and act as a gentle diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
